subject: Cybersecurity
title: Section 230: The Law That Built the Internet
description: A short lesson to help you apply Section 230: The Law That Built the Internet.

hook.text: 26 words written in 1996 created the legal foundation for every social media platform, forum, and review site on the internet.

buildup.text: Section 230 says online platforms aren’t liable for content posted by users. Without it, every tweet could trigger a lawsuit.

discovery.text: Section 230 also protects platforms that moderate content. They can remove posts without becoming legally responsible for choices.

twist.text: Both political sides want to reform Section 230 – for opposite reasons. One says too much is removed, the other says too little.

climax.text: Without Section 230, platforms would either censor everything to avoid lawsuits or allow everything to avoid accountability.

punchline.text: 26 words. Every social media platform depends on them.

quiz.question: What does Section 230 protect online platforms from?
options: Liability for content posted by their users
